gloss: even so; even if that is the case

definitions.gloss: even so; even if that is the case
definitions.explanation: Grants what was just said and introduces a point that still holds. At the start of a sentence it answers the previous one; after a noun or na-adjective (〜だとしても) it means "even if it is …".

examples.japanese: だとしても、⟦{遅刻|ちこく}→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Even so, being late isn't OK.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧だとしても⟦{言|い}い→言う：00515_iu⟧すぎだ。
examples.english: Even if it was a joke, that went too far.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忙|いそが}しかった→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。だとしても、⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧くらいはしてほしかった。
examples.english: I know you were busy. Even so, I'd have liked you to at least get in touch.

notes:
だ (copula) + とし (as, from ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧) + て⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (even if). Neutral in register; in formal writing そうだとしても or たとえそうであって⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [Sentence]。だとしても、〜: Even so, …
- [Noun / na-adj]だとしても: even if it is …
- [Verb / i-adj]として⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: even if (no だ): ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧として⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧

SIMILAR WORDS:
- だ⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧: but, however; simply contrasts, without conceding the point first
- ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: even so, still
- た⟦と→と：00512_to⟧え〜て⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: even if …, for hypotheticals
